independent_grade.notes: The change perfectly scopes the performance optimization to the render paths causing slowdowns by extracting the redundant-work conditions into well-named, isolated guards. It correctly handles the edge cases for specific territory-related roles that require fallback rendering, provides comprehensive unit tests, and fully complies with repo policies.
